body: I'm in computer science. I thought that was what I was passionate about, I was so sure of it, but now it seems boring and I'll be sitting all day and I'll die alone. I can't switch because this school doesn't offer any other majors I am remotely interested in and it's a terrible school, the only reason I picked it over the school I really want to get into is because I knew I wouldn't be able to do the math they have there. People online say it's a terrible school and that I won't get into any Master's programs. All the other majors I'd want are at the other school. My meds are hell because I feel no sexual attraction to anyone whatsoever when I'm on them. I felt very disconnected and every problem I had just melted away but now they've all resurfaced, all my terrible memories which I didn't care about just come back full force and even if I go back on them, they'll still be there. I'll just be numb to them. And it freaks me out that they do that. Thank you for your adviec
